items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I got a chance to see Al Cohn and Joe Benjamin and Budd Johnson and Earl Hines

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. At this time I took a leave of absence from this show that I was doing with Terry Gibbs, this operation entertainment, to do this thing with Bobby. And I was very happy that I did because I got a chance to see Al Cohn and Joe Benjamin and Budd Johnson and Earl Hines, and it was just like -- Grady. So from there we

went to New York, and Bobby hired Grady and I agreed to do the Today Show with us, we did the Today Show. And I was very happy to do this, and then I went back to California and re-joined Terry Gibbs on this Operation Entertainment. A very supersat good band. I don't know whether I told you, but the super saxes, that was just about ---that was our sax section on Terry's band. I mentioned that before, it was an excellent band. I enjoyed it.
